extracted.intended_audience: Authors submitting to the Journal of Clinical Investigation and institutional press officers; journalists interacting with in-press JCI material
extracted.subtask_description: Journal of Clinical Investigation rules governing embargoes, JCI-produced press releases, institutional press releases, and permissible prepublication communication with media for material submitted to or accepted by JCI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo on material under consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Material intended for submission to or currently under consideration at the Journal of Clinical Investigation (JCI) is under embargo and therefore must not be discussed with the media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For accepted material, the publication date will be confirmed upon receipt of publication proofs. The journal reserves the right to halt consideration or publication if the embargo policy is broken.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo lift timing
rubrics_metrics.description: All articles remain under embargo until 12:00 pm Eastern Time on the date of publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If authors opt to publish their article as an In-Press Preview prior to copyediting and layout, publication of the In-Press Preview version is considered the end of the embargo period.

rubrics_metrics.name: JCI right to halt consideration or publication
rubrics_metrics.description: The Journal reserves the right to halt the consideration or publication of a paper if the embargo policy is broken.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a discretionary enforcement action the Journal may take in response to embargo breaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of a press release by the JCI
rubrics_metrics.description: Prior to online publication of a batch of accepted articles, the JCI may choose to produce and distribute a short press release that summarizes select manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: JCI press releases include links to complete versions of highlighted articles on a secure website, as well as the name, phone number, and email address of the corresponding author. Access may also be granted to other relevant material, such as an accompanying Commentary. The content of the press release and the articles is embargoed until the time and date clearly stated on the press release. The content of the JCI press release remains at the discretion of the Editorial Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author-supplied institutional contact for JCI press release
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors who wish for the JCI press release to include contact information for their institutional press office should supply these details immediately following acceptance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide institutional press office contact details to the address provided by the Journal right after acceptance to have them included in the JCI-distributed press release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sanctions for journalists who break embargoes
rubrics_metrics.description: The Journal reserves the right to remove from its press release distribution list any journalists who break embargoes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breaking the stated embargo on JCI content can result in removal from future press distributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of a press release by an author’s institution
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors are welcome to produce and distribute a press release through their institutional press office no more than one week prior to the online publication date, provided the release clearly states the embargo date and time and that the work is being published in the JCI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sender of the institutional press release is responsible for confirming the final embargo information with the Journal in advance of distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepublication communication with the media
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors of in-press JCI articles may provide preprints, grant interviews, and discuss their work with members of the press, but not more than one week prior to online publication of their article, and provided that the journalist agrees to abide by the JCI embargo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are asked not to participate in public news conferences until the embargo has lifted. If a member of the media wishes to reprint figures and/or tables from a JCI article, the request should be directed to the JCI as outlined by the Journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation at scientific meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors are welcome to present material from their in-press JCI article to colleagues at scientific meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: However, authors should not comment beyond the content of their presentation, nor provide whole copies of their paper, presentation, or any part thereof to members of the press or other individuals in attendance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for embargo questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Any questions or issues regarding prepublication publicity or the JCI embargo policy should be directed to the Science Editor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact: Elyse Dankoski, PhD, Science Editor, Journal of Clinical Investigation. E-mail: press_releases@the-jci.org
